item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.completion`, which is the final outbound LiteLLM chat call DSPy reaches via `litellm_completion`, and inspects its kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `dspy.LM(model='openai/test-model', ...)` and passes `top_p`, `top_k`, `enable_thinking`, and `timeout` in the constructor."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `cache=False`, ensuring the invocation goes through the live completion path rather than a DSPy cache hit."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a mock response with `choices` entries exposing `message.content` and `finish_reason`, which is compatible with `LM.forward` and truncation checks."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Calls `lm('hello')`, triggering DSPy to create a user message from the prompt and assemble the outbound chat request."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Reads `patched.call_args.kwargs`, prints the relevant fields, and asserts exact values for `top_p`, `top_k`, `enable_thinking`, and `timeout`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
